question: Who led the Revolt of 1857 in Bihar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Veer Kunwar Singh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Veer Kunwar Singh:-**

 
 
• **​**Kunwar Singh belonged to the Rajput house of Jagdispur.
 
• He led the Revolt of 1857 from Bihar.
 
• He died at the age of 80 fighting the British soldiers.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Azimullah Khan:-**

 
 
• He was a key figure during the Indian Rebellion of 1857.
 
• He was a trusted advisor to Bahadur Shah II, the last Mughal emperor of India, and played a significant role in the events leading up to and during the rebellion.
 
 
 
• **Bakht Khan:-**
 
 
• He was a prominent figure during the Indian Rebellion of 1857.
 
• He was a soldier in the service of the British East India Company who later joined the rebellion against British rule.
 
• He played a significant role in the events of the uprising, particularly in Delhi.
 
 
 
• **Maulvi Ahmadullah Shah;-**
 
 
• He is also known as Maulvi Ahmadullah.
 
• He was an important figure in the Indian Rebellion of 1857.
 
• He was a prominent leader and a religious cleric who played a significant role in organizing and leading the rebellion in the region of Awadh (Oudh), which is present-day Uttar Pradesh in India.
